rule: act when both option orders name the same item, neither names none, and min(confidence) >= t2; OR one order names item X with confidence >= asym_item while the other names none with confidence <= asym_none (accept X); when the two orders name DIFFERENT items: the pairwise tie-break (the two items + none, both orders; act only when both orders name the same item and neither names none)
selection: the most accepted picks with confident-wrong <= 3 % pooled AND on the web-only seen rows (<= 1 of 41)

seen_data.web2: web-arch3 analysis/picker_gold_r2.json (n=26, gold set blind to the picks)

tie_break_note: the pairwise tie-break needs new model calls: it cannot be scored on logged answers; it is frozen by its rule (the same consistency test), its live accuracy is reported
options: richer: title, price, a snippet of the item's card and the link path within OpenJev's 120 characters
